column1: # Every constant row the VideoToolbox registry holds, and the held-cache release that first EXPORTS
# each one - or '-', meaning NO held cache exports it, which is a MEASUREMENT and not a silence.
# WHY EVERY REGISTRY ROW AND NOT ONLY THE 135 THE PORT DEFINES: this table used to be built from the
# port's own objects, so it held those 135 and nothing else, and 'the table says nothing' could be
# read as 'no held cache exports it'. Those are different claims, and 13 rows - the kVTProfileLevel
# levels, which the release exports itself - were unaccountable for. A registry constant row absent
# from this table is now a FAILURE of check-registered.py, so the two can no longer be confused.
# MEASURED with tools/vt-ladder-names.lua, which calls the same module tools/release-split.lua calls:
# There is no exports reader here: a second one is the two-implementations failure this family has
# produced four times, and the export tries are why a byte search cannot answer this -
# The SDK directory is the one a gate's build records in build/objects/sdkdir, passed as an
# argument, because first_releases keys its kept measurement on it:
# TWO CONTROLS, printed on every run and required for any row to be believed:
#   kVTProfileLevel_H264_Baseline_4_0   must come back with a rung - it is 7.0
#   a nonsense name                     must come back '-'
# HELD CACHE RELEASES MEASURED AGAINST, oldest first:
# constant<TAB>release  - TAB separated; '-' alone means no held cache exports it
